LESSON: THE CALL OF DISCIPLES

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: The Life of Jesus Christ
Topic 3.1: The Call of Disciples

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on The Call of Disciples. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: How did the disciples respond to the call of Jesus Christ?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. retell the call of the first disciples as guided by the scriptures
2. state how different people are called to serve God today

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: THE CALL OF DISCIPLES
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION · Grade: Grade 6
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
The Call of Disciples helps you succeed in CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION. You will understand it, practise it, and use it at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

KEY FACTS: THE CALL OF DISCIPLES
Study The Call of Disciples like a learner textbook page: meaning → examples → practice → check.
Replace teacher words with your own words.
If a step is unclear, rewrite it shorter and try again.

PART 1: Retell the call of the first disciples as guided by the scriptures

What this means
In this part you learn to retell the call of the first disciples as guided by the scriptures. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: retell the call of the first disciples as guided by the scriptures.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Value in action: Show how “The Call of Disciples” looks when you treat a classmate kindly.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can retell the call of the first disciples as guided by the scriptures. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 2: State how different people are called to serve God today

What this means
In this part you learn to state how different people are called to serve God today. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: state how different people are called to serve God today.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Story link: Retell a short faith/values story connected to The Call of Disciples in your own words.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can state how different people are called to serve God today. Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what The Call of Disciples is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Show how “The Call of Disciples” looks when you treat a classmate kindly. (skill: retell the call of the first disciples as guided by the scriptures)

Example 2: Retell a short faith/values story connected to The Call of Disciples in your own words. (skill: state how different people are called to serve God today)

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach The Call of Disciples to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: retell the call of the first disciples as guided by the scriptures.
3. Practise this skill: state how different people are called to serve God today.
4. Make one local Kenya example of The Call of Disciples from your county, market, farm, or school.
5. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for The Call of Disciples: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a Grade 6 learner study The Call of Disciples?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How did the disciples respond to the call of Jesus Christ?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Know what The Call of Disciples means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: retell the call of the first disciples as guided by the scriptures.
5. Be able to: state how different people are called to serve God today.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
